name: Min Stack
description: A stack that supports push, pop, top, and getMin in O(1) time by maintaining a parallel minimum-tracking stack.
aim: Support O(1) minimum retrieval at any point by keeping a second "min stack" that records the current minimum at each push.
howItWorks: Min stack: push min(current element, top of min stack) on each push
On pop: pop from both stacks
getMin: return top of min stack

complexity.spaceDescription: Two stacks of size n each

realWorld: Database query optimizer — track minimum selectivity
Stock analysis — track running minimum prices
Game development — track minimum score efficiently
whenToUse: Need O(1) minimum tracking in stack
Undo operations that need to restore minimum
alternatives: Single stack with pairs (value, min) — same complexity
Segment tree — O(log n) if range min needed
